name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana

clauses.text: Individual bank account holders of participating banks aged between 18 years (completed) and 70 years (age nearer birthday) who give their consent to join / enable auto-debit, will be enrolled into the scheme.

The accident cover of the member shall terminate / be restricted accordingly on attaining age 70 years (age nearer birth day), or on closure of account with the Bank or insufficiency of balance to keep the insurance in force.

documents_required: Duly filled PMSBY enrolment form, submitted at the bank branch where the savings account is held (or enrolment via the bank's net banking)
